# Agent Python Tools

- repo: google-deepmind/concordia
- repo_uri: https://github.com/google-deepmind/concordia

## File: google-deepmind_concordia/examples/signaling/configs/personas.py

Prompts

```
['load persona instances and agent data for a signaling marketplace simulation with configurable number of agents', 'generate cash values for agents using pareto or mixed wealth distribution types', 'generate mixed-sex date pairings for each day ensuring no repeated pairings across days', 'generate same-sex conversation pairings for each day with leftover handling for odd group sizes', 'generate random disjoint pairs from a list of names with optional leftover handling']
```

Usage

```
{'load_personas': 'load persona instances and agent data for a signaling marketplace simulation with configurable number of agents', 'generate_cash_values': 'generate cash values for agents using pareto or mixed wealth distribution types', 'generate_mixed_sex_dates': 'generate mixed-sex date pairings for each day ensuring no repeated pairings across days', 'generate_same_sex_convos': 'generate same-sex conversation pairings for each day with leftover handling for odd group sizes', 'generate_disjoint_dyads': 'generate random disjoint pairs from a list of names with optional leftover handling'}
```
